note: Measure word 套 tou3. 著西裝 = wear a suit.

ex.s: 今日要見客，我著咗西裝。
ex.r: gam1 jat6 jiu3 gin3 haak3 ngo5 zoek3 zo2 sai1 zong1
ex.en: I'm meeting a client today, so I wore a suit.

ex.r: ni1 tou3 sai1 zong1 gei2 cin2 aa3
ex.en: How much is this suit?

ex.r: jam2 jin3 sai2 m4 sai2 zoek3 sai1 zong1 gaa3
ex.en: Do I need to wear a suit to the banquet?

note: 救命呀！ = Help!

ex.r: gau3 meng6 aa3
ex.en: Help!

ex.r: ji1 sang1 gau3 faan1 keoi5
ex.en: The doctor saved him.

ex.r: nei5 gam1 jat6 gau3 zo2 ngo5 aa3 do1 ze6
ex.en: You saved me today, thanks!

en: to break, snap; be cut off
note: Colloquial tyun5 = snap; formal words use dyun6/dyun3 (e.g. 判斷 pun3 dyun3).

ex.r: ngo5 tiu4 fu3 daai2 tyun5 zo2
ex.en: My belt snapped.

ex.r: gong2 gong2 haa5 din6 waa2 tyun5 zo2 sin3
ex.en: The call got cut off while we were talking.

ex.r: keoi5 dit3 tyun5 zo2 zek3 goek3
ex.en: He fell and broke his leg.

note: Polite word for wife; casual 老婆 lou5 po4. 陳太 = Mrs. Chan.

ex.r: ngo5 taai3 taai2 zung1 ji3 zyu2 je5 sik6
ex.en: My wife likes cooking.

ex.r: can4 taai3 taai2 zou2 san4
ex.en: Good morning, Mrs. Chan!

ex.r: nei5 taai3 taai2 gam1 maan5 lai4 m4 lai4 aa3
ex.en: Is your wife coming tonight?

note: 管理處 = building management office.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 gun2 lei5 sap6 go3 jan4
ex.en: He manages ten people at the company.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 sik1 gun2 lei5 di1 cin2
ex.en: I don't know how to manage my money.

ex.r: ni1 dung6 daai6 haa6 gun2 lei5 dak1 gei2 hou2
ex.en: This building is managed pretty well.

note: One-way is 單程 daan1 cing4.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 jat1 zoeng1 loi4 wui4 fei1
ex.en: I'd like a round-trip ticket.

ex.r: heoi3 gei1 coeng4 loi4 wui4 jiu3 loeng5 go3 zung1
ex.en: A round trip to the airport takes two hours.

ex.s: 我每日來回返工要一個鐘。
ex.r: ngo5 mui5 jat6 loi4 wui4 faan1 gung1 jiu3 jat1 go3 zung1
ex.en: My commute takes an hour there and back every day.

note: Spoken form; avoid Mandarin 今天早上. 聽朝 = tomorrow morning.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 ci4 zo2 hei2 san1
ex.en: I got up late this morning.

ex.r: gam1 ziu1 hou2 dung3 aa3
ex.en: It was really cold this morning.

ex.r: nei5 gam1 ziu1 sik6 zo2 zou2 caan1 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Did you have breakfast this morning?

ex.s: 呢部手機有好多新功能。
ex.r: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jau5 hou2 do1 san1 gung1 nang4
ex.en: This phone has lots of new features.

ex.r: ni1 go3 zai3 jau5 me1 gung1 nang4 gaa3
ex.en: What does this button do?

ex.r: bou6 sai2 ji1 gei1 jau5 gon1 ji1 gung1 nang4
ex.en: The washing machine has a drying function.

note: Also a measure word for sets: 一組 = one set/group.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 fan1 hoi1 saam1 zou2 zou6 gung1 fo3
ex.en: We split into three groups to do the homework.

ex.r: nei5 hai2 bin1 jat1 zou2 aa3
ex.en: Which group are you in?

ex.s: 我喺公司嘅設計組做嘢。
ex.r: ngo5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 cit3 gai3 zou2 zou6 je5
ex.en: I work on the company's design team.

ex.r: nei5 syu2 gaa3 jau5 me1 gai3 waak6 aa3
ex.en: What are your plans for the summer break?

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 ming4 nin2 heoi3 jat6 bun2
ex.en: We're planning to go to Japan next year.

ex.r: keoi5 gai3 waak6 cyu5 cin2 maai5 lau2
ex.en: She's planning to save up to buy a flat.

note: Slangy; usually negative (arrogant, making a fuss), sometimes admiring.

ex.r: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zau6 hou2 baa1 bai3
ex.en: Since he got promoted he's been so full of himself.

ex.r: jau5 cin2 zau6 hou2 baa1 bai3 me1
ex.en: So having money makes you a big shot?

ex.s: 你識講五種語言，好巴閉呀！
ex.r: nei5 sik1 gong2 ng5 zung2 jyu5 jin4 hou2 baa1 bai3 aa3
ex.en: You speak five languages? That's impressive!

ex.r: sik6 jyun4 ni1 caan1 hou2 mun5 zuk1 aa3
ex.en: I feel so satisfied after this meal.

ex.s: 佢有屋企人陪就好滿足。
ex.r: keoi5 jau5 uk1 kei2 jan4 pui4 zau6 hou2 mun5 zuk1
ex.en: She's content just having her family around.

ex.r: jan4 jiu3 sik1 mun5 zuk1
ex.en: You have to learn to be content.

note: 城市 sing4 si5 is the usual word for 'city'; 城 appears in names like 九龍城.

ex.r: ni1 go3 sing4 maan5 tau4 je2 hou2 jit6 naau6
ex.en: This city is really lively at night.

ex.r: keoi5 bun1 zo2 heoi3 dai6 ji6 go3 sing4 zyu6
ex.en: He moved to another city.

ex.r: ni1 tou3 hei3 cyun4 sing4 dou1 gong2 gan2
ex.en: The whole city is talking about this movie.

note: Measure word 隻 zek3; 手錶 sau2 biu1 also common.

ex.r: ngo5 zek3 biu1 ting4 zo2
ex.en: My watch stopped.

ex.s: 佢生日我送咗隻錶畀佢。
ex.r: keoi5 saang1 jat6 ngo5 sung3 zo2 zek3 biu1 bei2 keoi5
ex.en: I gave him a watch for his birthday.

ex.r: ni1 zek3 biu1 fong4 m4 fong4 seoi2 gaa3
ex.en: Is this watch waterproof?

note: Measure word 隊 deoi2.

ex.r: ngo5 sai3 lou2 waan2 ngok6 deoi2 keoi5 daa2 gu2
ex.en: My little brother's in a band; he plays drums.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 zau2 baa1 jau5 ngok6 deoi2 biu2 jin2
ex.en: There's a band playing at the bar tonight.

ex.r: nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 bin1 deoi2 ngok6 deoi2 aa3
ex.en: Which band is your favorite?

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 wun6 go3 waa6 tai4 laa1
ex.en: Let's change the subject.

ex.r: tin1 hei3 hai6 zeoi3 ngon1 cyun4 ge3 waa6 tai4
ex.en: The weather is the safest topic.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 jau5 waa6 tai4 gong2
ex.en: Those two always have lots to talk about.

note: Follows the event: 考試期間 = during exams.

ex.r: san1 nin4 kei4 gaan1 di1 gei1 piu3 hou2 gwai3
ex.en: Plane tickets are expensive over New Year.

ex.s: 我住院期間佢日日嚟睇我。
ex.r: ngo5 zyu6 jyun2 kei4 gaan1 keoi5 jat6 jat6 lai4 tai2 ngo5
ex.en: She came to see me every day while I was in hospital.

ex.r: haau2 si5 kei4 gaan1 ngo5 m4 ceot1 gaai1
ex.en: I don't go out during exams.

note: Measure word 段 dyun6 or 條 tiu4.

ex.r: ni1 dyun6 jing2 pin2 hou2 hou2 siu3
ex.en: This video is so funny.

ex.s: 我拍咗段影片畀阿媽睇。
ex.r: ngo5 paak3 zo2 dyun6 jing2 pin2 bei2 aa3 maa1 tai2
ex.en: I filmed a video for Mom to watch.

ex.s: 佢教人煮飯嘅影片好多人睇。
ex.r: keoi5 gaau3 jan4 zyu2 faan6 ge3 jing2 pin2 hou2 do1 jan4 tai2
ex.en: Lots of people watch her cooking videos.

ex.r: ni1 deoi3 haai4 zi3 siu2 ng5 baak3 man1
ex.en: These shoes cost at least five hundred dollars.

ex.r: nei5 zi3 siu2 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2 laa1
ex.en: At least drink more water.

ex.s: 呢間餐廳至少要等半個鐘。
ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zi3 siu2 jiu3 dang2 bun3 go3 zung1
ex.en: You have to wait at least half an hour at this restaurant.

note: For snapping in two use 斷 tyun5. 打破 = break by knocking or dropping.

ex.r: ngo5 gin6 saam1 po3 zo2 go3 lung1
ex.en: My shirt has a hole in it.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 daa2 po3 zo2 zek3 wun2
ex.en: I accidentally broke a bowl.

ex.r: keoi5 dit3 can1 sat1 tau4 po3 zo2 pei4
ex.en: She fell and scraped her knee.

note: For 'day' spoken Cantonese prefers 日 jat6 (三日, not 三天).

ex.r: gam1 jat6 go3 tin1 hou2 laam4
ex.en: The sky is really blue today.

ex.r: tin1 hak1 laa3 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1
ex.en: It's dark now, let's go home.

ex.r: keoi5 zou6 dou3 tin1 gwong1 sin1 fan3
ex.en: He worked until dawn before going to bed.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 din6 si6 jin2 jyun4
ex.en: She's a TV actress.

ex.s: 呢套戲啲演員演得好好。
ex.r: ni1 tou3 hei3 di1 jin2 jyun4 jin2 dak1 hou2 hou2
ex.en: The actors in this movie are really good.

ex.r: ngo5 sai3 go3 soeng2 zou6 jin2 jyun4
ex.en: When I was little I wanted to be an actor.

note: Measure word 隻 zek3. 豬肉 = pork.

ex.r: nung4 coeng4 jau5 hou2 do1 zyu1 tung4 ngau4
ex.en: The farm has lots of pigs and cows.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 zyu1 paa2
ex.en: I want a pork chop tonight.

ex.r: nei5 fan3 dou3 hou2 ci5 zek3 zyu1 gam2
ex.en: You sleep like a pig.

note: 抄低 = write down, jot down.

ex.r: m4 hou2 caau1 jan4 dei6 gung1 fo3 aa3
ex.en: Don't copy other people's homework!

ex.s: 我抄低你個電話號碼先。
ex.r: ngo5 caau1 dai1 nei5 go3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 sin1
ex.en: Let me jot down your phone number first.

ex.r: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 caau1 jan4 dei6 gaa3
ex.en: This design is copied from someone else.

note: In speech 整 zing2 is also common: 整返好 = fix it.

ex.r: bou6 laang5 hei3 waai6 zo2 jiu3 wan2 jan4 sau1
ex.en: The AC is broken; I need to get someone to fix it.

ex.r: sau1 bou6 din6 waa2 jiu3 gei2 cin2 aa3
ex.en: How much does it cost to fix the phone?

ex.r: ngo5 lou5 gung1 sik1 zi6 gei2 sau1 daan1 ce1
ex.en: My husband can fix bikes himself.

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 zyu2 dung6 bong1 sau2
ex.en: He's always quick to offer help.

ex.r: nei5 zyu2 dung6 di1 tung4 keoi5 gong2 laa1
ex.en: Take the initiative and talk to her.

ex.r: faan1 gung1 jiu3 zyu2 dung6 di1 man6 je5
ex.en: At work you should be more proactive about asking questions.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 hou2 ceot1 meng2 ge3 go1 sau2
ex.en: She's a very famous singer.

ex.r: nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 bin1 go3 go1 sau2 aa3
ex.en: Who's your favorite singer?

ex.r: ngo5 go3 neoi2 soeng2 zou6 go1 sau2
ex.en: My daughter wants to be a singer.

note: Measure word 張 zoeng1. 'Watch' is 錶 biu1, a different character.

ex.r: m4 goi1 tin4 zo2 ni1 zoeng1 biu2 sin1
ex.en: Please fill out this form first.

ex.r: zoeng1 si4 gaan3 biu2 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3
ex.en: Where's the timetable?

ex.r: ngo5 tai2 m4 ming4 ni1 go3 biu2
ex.en: I don't understand this chart.

ex.r: ngo5 dung3 dou3 seng4 san1 zan3
ex.en: I'm so cold my whole body is shaking.

ex.r: nei5 bou6 din6 waa2 zan3 gan2 aa3
ex.en: Your phone is vibrating.

ex.r: gaa3 baa1 si2 hou2 zan3 aa3
ex.en: This bus is really bumpy.

note: 副作用 fu3 zok3 jung6 = side effect.

ex.r: sik6 zo2 joek6 dou1 mou5 zok3 jung6
ex.en: The medicine had no effect.

ex.r: gam2 joeng2 zou6 jau5 me1 zok3 jung6 aa3
ex.en: What's the point of doing it like that?

ex.r: wan6 dung6 deoi3 fan3 gaau3 hou2 jau5 zok3 jung6
ex.en: Exercise really helps with sleep.

note: 兜風 = go for a drive. 兜圈 = go in circles.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 soeng1 coeng4 dau1 jat1 zan6 sin1
ex.en: Let's wander around the mall for a bit first.

ex.r: dik1 si2 dau1 zo2 hou2 jyun5 lou6
ex.en: The taxi took a long detour.

ex.r: m4 hou2 dau1 hyun1 zik6 zip3 gong2 laa1
ex.en: Stop beating around the bush and just say it.

ex.r: zoeng1 soeng2 go3 bui3 ging2 hou2 leng3
ex.en: The background of the photo is beautiful.

ex.r: keoi5 gaa1 ting4 bui3 ging2 hou2 gaan2 daan1
ex.en: Her family background is very ordinary.

ex.r: ngo5 mou5 duk6 din6 nou5 ge3 bui3 ging2
ex.en: I don't have a background in computers.

ex.r: go3 dou6 jau4 gong2 je5 hou2 hou2 siu3
ex.en: The tour guide is really funny.

ex.s: 我哋請咗個導遊帶我哋行山。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 go3 dou6 jau4 daai3 ngo5 dei6 haang4 saan1
ex.en: We hired a guide to take us hiking.

ex.s: 導遊叫我哋三點返上車。
ex.r: dou6 jau4 giu3 ngo5 dei6 saam1 dim2 faan1 soeng5 ce1
ex.en: The guide told us to be back on the bus at three.

ex.s: 呢套戲嘅導演係邊個呀？
ex.r: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 dou6 jin2 hai6 bin1 go3 aa3
ex.en: Who directed this movie?

ex.r: keoi5 jau4 jin2 jyun4 zyun3 zo2 zou6 dou6 jin2
ex.en: He switched from acting to directing.

ex.s: 我好鍾意呢個導演嘅戲。
ex.r: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 ni1 go3 dou6 jin2 ge3 hei3
ex.en: I really like this director's films.

ex.r: do1 ze6 nei5 jat1 zik6 gu2 lai6 ngo5
ex.en: Thanks for always encouraging me.

ex.s: 醫生鼓勵佢多啲做運動。
ex.r: ji1 sang1 gu2 lai6 keoi5 do1 di1 zou6 wan6 dung6
ex.en: The doctor encouraged him to exercise more.

ex.s: 老師鼓勵我哋多啲發問。
ex.r: lou5 si1 gu2 lai6 ngo5 dei6 do1 di1 faat3 man6
ex.en: The teacher encourages us to ask more questions.

note: 煮飯 = cook a meal (or cook rice).

ex.r: gam1 maan5 ngo5 zyu2 faan6
ex.en: I'm cooking tonight.

ex.r: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 zyu2 min6 aa3
ex.en: Do you know how to cook noodles?

ex.r: dip6 coi3 zyu2 dak1 taai3 haam4 laa3
ex.en: The vegetables are cooked too salty.

note: Pattern: 就嚟 + verb + 喇. Also 就快 zau6 faai3.

ex.r: ngo5 zau6 lai4 dou3 laa3
ex.en: I'm almost there.

ex.r: zau6 lai4 lok6 jyu5 laa3 daai3 ze1 laa1
ex.en: It's about to rain; take an umbrella.

ex.r: zau6 lai4 fong3 gaa3 laa3 hou2 hoi1 sam1
ex.en: The holidays are almost here, so happy!

note: 睇牙醫 = go to the dentist.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1
ex.en: I have to go to the dentist tomorrow.

ex.r: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 mok1 ngaa4
ex.en: The dentist says I need a tooth pulled.

ex.s: 佢係牙醫，喺中環開診所。
ex.r: keoi5 hai6 ngaa4 ji1 hai2 zung1 waan4 hoi1 can2 so2
ex.en: He's a dentist with a clinic in Central.

ex.r: gam1 jat6 di1 jan4 siu2 dak1 hou2 ceot1 kei4
ex.en: There are surprisingly few people today.

ex.r: keoi5 gam3 ci4 dou1 mei6 dou3 hou2 ceot1 kei4
ex.en: It's strange that he's still not here this late.

ex.s: 有咩出奇呀？佢成日都係咁。
ex.r: jau5 me1 ceot1 kei4 aa3 keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 gam2
ex.en: What's so surprising? He's always like that.

ex.r: saan1 deng2 ge3 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3
ex.en: The view from the Peak is beautiful.

ex.r: ngo5 co5 fo2 ce1 tai2 fung1 ging2
ex.en: I took the train and enjoyed the scenery.

ex.s: 呢度風景咁靚，影張相啦。
ex.r: ni1 dou6 fung1 ging2 gam3 leng3 jing2 zoeng1 soeng2 laa1
ex.en: The scenery's so nice here, let's take a photo.

note: Casual, for a man (often younger); don't use for elders or to his face formally.

ex.r: go2 go3 jau2 zai2 hai6 bin1 go3 lai4 gaa3
ex.en: Who's that guy?

ex.r: go3 jau2 zai2 bong1 ngo5 bun1 zo2 di1 je5
ex.en: That guy helped me move my stuff.

ex.r: san1 lai4 go3 jau2 zai2 gei2 kan4 lik6 wo3
ex.en: The new guy is pretty hardworking.

note: At roast-meat shops: 斬料 = buy chopped roast meat.

ex.r: m4 goi1 zaam2 bun3 zek3 siu1 ngo2
ex.en: Half a roast goose, chopped, please.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 cyu4 fong2 zaam2 gan2 gai1
ex.en: He's chopping chicken in the kitchen.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 pou3 hou2 zaam2 jan4
ex.en: This shop really rips people off.

note: Spoken word for tired; avoid Mandarin 累. Also written 癐.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gui6 aa3
ex.en: I'm so tired today.

ex.r: haang4 zo2 seng4 jat6 gui6 dou3 sei2
ex.en: I walked all day; I'm dead tired.

ex.r: nei5 gui6 zau6 zou2 di1 fan3 laa1
ex.en: If you're tired, go to bed early.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 hoi2 ngoi6 duk6 syu1
ex.en: She's studying overseas.

ex.r: ngo5 go4 go1 hai2 hoi2 ngoi6 zou6 je5
ex.en: My older brother works overseas.

ex.s: 喺海外用張卡要唔要收費呀？
ex.r: hai2 hoi2 ngoi6 jung6 zoeng1 kaat1 jiu3 m4 jiu3 sau1 fai3 aa3
ex.en: Is there a fee for using the card overseas?

note: Place word often ends in 度: 擺落枱度 = put on the table.

ex.r: baai2 lok6 toi2 dou6 sin1 laa1
ex.en: Put it down on the table first.

ex.r: nei5 baai2 lok6 syut3 gwai6 laa1
ex.en: Put it in the fridge.

ex.r: baai2 lok6 go3 doi2 dou6 dak1 laa3
ex.en: Just put it in the bag.

ex.r: ngo5 waai4 ji4 keoi5 aak1 ngo5
ex.en: I suspect he's lying to me.

ex.r: ji1 sang1 waai4 ji4 ngo5 sik6 mat6 zung3 duk6
ex.en: The doctor suspects I have food poisoning.

ex.s: 我懷疑自己唔記得鎖門。
ex.r: ngo5 waai4 ji4 zi6 gei2 m4 gei3 dak1 so2 mun4
ex.en: I think I may have forgotten to lock the door.

ex.r: san1 nin4 jiu3 heoi3 taam3 can1 cik1
ex.en: At New Year we have to visit relatives.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 jyun5 fong4 can1 cik1
ex.en: He's a distant relative of mine.

ex.s: 我啲親戚好多都喺加拿大。
ex.r: ngo5 di1 can1 cik1 hou2 do1 dou1 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6
ex.en: Many of my relatives are in Canada.

note: Older brother: 哥哥 go4 go1 or 大佬 daai6 lou2.

ex.r: ngo5 sai3 lou2 gam1 nin2 sap6 baat3 seoi3
ex.en: My little brother is eighteen this year.

ex.r: nei5 jau5 mou5 sai3 lou2 aa3
ex.en: Do you have a younger brother?

ex.r: giu3 sai3 lou2 bong1 sau2 zap1 fong2 laa1
ex.en: Get your little brother to help tidy the room.

note: On signs: 禁止 gam3 zi2 + verb = 'No ...'.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 gam3 zi2 sik6 jin1
ex.en: Smoking is not allowed here.

ex.r: keoi5 aa3 maa1 gam3 keoi5 daa2 gei1
ex.en: His mom banned him from playing video games.

ex.r: wing6 ci4 gam3 zi2 tiu3 seoi2
ex.en: Diving is not allowed in the pool.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 jam1 ngok6 hok6 jyun2 duk6 syu1
ex.en: She studies at a music academy.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 ji1 hok6 jyun2 gaau3 syu1
ex.en: I teach at a medical school.

ex.r: hok6 jyun2 gam1 maan5 jau5 wut6 dung6
ex.en: The college has an event tonight.

note: Same as 本來 bun2 loi4.

ex.r: ngo5 jyun4 sin1 soeng2 heoi3 jat6 bun2
ex.en: I originally wanted to go to Japan.

ex.s: 原先約咗三點，改咗四點。
ex.r: jyun4 sin1 joek3 zo2 saam1 dim2 goi2 zo2 sei3 dim2
ex.en: It was set for three, but got moved to four.

ex.r: keoi5 jyun4 sin1 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 laat6
ex.en: At first she didn't like spicy food.

ex.r: gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 hou2 hing1 sung1
ex.en: Work was really easy today.

ex.r: hing1 sung1 di1 laa1 m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1
ex.en: Relax, no need to be so nervous.

ex.r: ni1 go3 haau2 si5 hou2 hing1 sung1
ex.en: This exam is a breeze.

note: Measure word 篇 pin1.

ex.r: nei5 tai2 zo2 go2 pin1 man4 zoeng1 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you read that article yet?

ex.r: keoi5 se2 ge3 man4 zoeng1 hou2 ji6 ming4
ex.en: Her articles are easy to understand.

ex.r: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 se2 pin1 man4 zoeng1
ex.en: The teacher told us to write an essay.

note: 出糧 = get paid. Also means feed: 狗糧 = dog food.

ex.r: gam1 jat6 ceot1 loeng4 ngo5 ceng2 sik6 faan6
ex.en: It's payday today, dinner's on me!

ex.r: nei5 fan6 gung1 gei2 do1 loeng4 aa3
